data.message: Finished! Heading down to lower engine next if you want to come along, Frank.

I just found Diana dead in security. My path this round was storage, then medbay, electrical, and finally security. The only person I ran into was Frank, who was hanging around medbay from about tick 3 to 5. Did anyone happen to see someone leaving security or hanging around the right side of the map? I didn't see anyone else on my way there. Let's piece this together.

I can completely back up Charlie's early path. My route was electrical, then medbay, upper engine, and finally oxygen. I was in medbay from tick 3 to 5 and saw Charlie walk in from storage exactly like he said. 

After I left medbay, I went to upper engine and ran into Alice. I was with her from tick 7 to 9, and at tick 10 she headed down toward lower engine. Since Alice and I were all the way on the left side of the map late in the round, and Charlie was moving from the middle to the right, that leaves Bob and Eve. 

Bob, Eve — where were you two? Since Diana was found in security, the killer had to be hanging around the right side of the map (weapons, navigation, or cafeteria). We need your paths to piece this together.

I can confirm Frank's story completely. My route was cafeteria, then oxygen, and down to upper engine. I saw Frank walk into upper engine from the medbay side at tick 7, and we were in there together until tick 10. After that, I headed down to lower engine to work on my fuel task, which is where I was when the meeting was called. 

Since Diana was killed all the way over in security, there's no physical way Frank or I could have done it—we were anchored to the extreme left side of the map when the kill had to have happened. 

With Frank vouching for Charlie early on, and Charlie reporting the body, I'm highly inclined to trust both of them. That leaves exactly what Frank just pointed out: Bob and Eve. One of you has to be the Duck. You are the only two completely unaccounted for, and you must have been on the right side of the ship near security. Let's hear your paths.

Okay, let me lay out my round honestly. I started in weapons — Bob was in there with me at ticks 1 and 2. He came in from the security side. After that I cut up to cafeteria, then down to medbay, and finished in electrical where I was when the meeting got called. I never actually set foot in security or navigation myself.

But here's the thing, Frank and Alice — Bob absolutely was on the right side of the map. He was in weapons with me early, and he came IN from security. So we know for a fact Bob was floating around that whole right wing — security, weapons, navigation. That's exactly the area Diana died in.

I'd also point out: I never crossed paths with Charlie or Frank or Alice on the left side because I was sweeping through the middle — cafeteria to medbay to electrical. That's a clean middle-spine route.

So between me and Bob: I can place Bob in weapons coming from security early. Bob needs to tell us where he went after weapons, because if he drifted back toward security or navigation, he had every opportunity to catch Diana alone. Bob, your turn — be specific about your path after weapons.

Wow, Eve. That is a massive lie, and you just got caught red-handed. 

You just claimed to the whole group that you never set foot in security, but I can prove you're the Duck right now. My actual path was security, then weapons, back down to security, and finally navigation. 

Here is exactly what happened: at tick 2, I saw you leave weapons and head directly into SECURITY, not the cafeteria like you claim. But it gets worse for you. At tick 6, I was back in security. And guess who I saw there? Both you AND Diana. Diana walked into security from navigation at tick 6, and you were already in there. 

After that, I moved down to navigation to do my Chart Course task, leaving you and Diana alone in security. Charlie found her body in that exact room. 

Since Alice and Frank have cleared each other on the left side, and Charlie found the body after coming from the middle, it was between me and Eve. Eve just lied about her entire path to cover up the fact that she was in the murder room with the victim. 

It's 100% Eve. Everyone, vote Eve.

Since everyone has laid out their paths, this is actually an easy puzzle to solve. Eve, your story completely falls apart when compared to my own route. 

You claimed you went from weapons to cafeteria, then down to medbay and finished in electrical. But Frank and I were in medbay from tick 3 to 5, and then I moved directly into electrical. I never saw you in medbay, and I never saw you in electrical. If your path was the "clean middle-spine route" like you claimed, our paths would have definitely crossed. 

Bob's testimony puts you in security with Diana right before she died, and your fake path directly contradicts what Frank and I actually experienced in the middle rooms. You're lying to cover up the kill. 

It's 100% Eve. We vote Eve here.

I couldn't agree more with Charlie. Eve, your alibi is completely busted. 

I was in medbay from tick 3 to tick 5, and I never saw you there. Charlie and I would have definitely bumped into you if you took that middle path like you claimed. Since you're clearly lying about your route to avoid being placed in security where Diana died, and Bob's testimony directly puts you in the murder room with the victim... this is an open and shut case.

Good catch, Bob and Charlie. I'm voting Eve.

I'm completely on board with this. Eve, your story just doesn't add up at all. Since Frank and I were together on the far left side, we know we're clear, and Frank's timeline has been rock solid. Bob caught you in security with Diana right around the time of the kill, and both Frank and Charlie have confirmed you were never in the middle rooms when you claimed to be. The lies are too obvious, and all the evidence points directly to you. This is an open-and-shut case. I'll be voting for Eve.

Hold on, everyone — before you all lock this in, listen carefully to what Bob just admitted. He said his path was security, weapons, BACK to security, then navigation. He just told you he was in security TWICE, including at tick 6 with Diana. He's the one who placed himself in the murder room with the victim, not me.

Okay, I'll be honest — I misspoke earlier when I said I never set foot in security. I cut through security briefly between weapons and cafeteria, that's true. But here's what I actually saw: at tick 6 I was passing through security and Diana walked in from navigation. Bob was ALSO there. Then Bob left toward navigation and I cut up to cafeteria. Diana was still alive when I left her.

Think about it logically. Bob is the ONLY person placing me anywhere suspicious. Everyone else's "evidence" against me is just "I didn't see Eve in my room" — but absence of evidence isn't evidence. Charlie, you went storage -> medbay -> electrical -> security. I went weapons -> security -> cafeteria -> medbay -> electrical. We were never in the same room at the same time because we were on different schedules through the middle. That's not proof I'm lying — that's just timing.

Bob, by his OWN admission, was in security, left, and came back to security again right when Diana arrived. He had cooldown, opportunity, and motive to frame me. He's spinning a confident story because he knows if you all vote me out, he wins.

I know this looks bad for me. But if you eject me and Diana's killer is actually Bob, you lose the game next round. Please — at least consider that the loudest accuser with the most detailed "I saw everything" story is usually the Duck. Vote Bob.

Eve's desperate backtrack is all the proof we need. First she says, "I never actually set foot in security," and tries to build a completely fake middle-spine route. Then, once Frank and Charlie confirm she wasn't in the middle rooms and I call her out for being in security with Diana, she suddenly says, "Okay, I'll be honest, I misspoke, I was in security." 

You don't "misspeak" about your entire route and then miraculously remember you were in the murder room only after getting caught. 

Alice, Frank, and Charlie — your logic is spotless. We have her cornered. She just confessed to being in the murder room after lying about it. Let's finish this and win the game. Vote Eve.
